segments.text: V. 30. He enjoined them Silence for the preſent, 1. That He might not encourage the People to ſet Him up for a temporal King; 2. That He might not provoke the Scribes and Phariſees to deſtroy Him before the Time; and 3. That He might not foreſtall the brighter Evidence which was to be given of his divine Character after his Reſurrection.
